verdict.rationale: Increase provides the event plumbing for automation but not a native rules engine. Webhooks call your application so it can take action automatically, a List Events API covers batch processing, and Real-Time Decision webhooks let your own servers approve or decline card authorizations as they happen. The rules themselves must live in your own code. Missing for 10: a native, user-configurable rule definition engine (event → condition → action) within Increase, no-code or declarative automation configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration.
